name: Galvantula
flavor_text: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

text.name: Discharge
text.text: Discard all {L} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

text.name: Muddy Bolt
text.text: If this Pokémon has any {F} Energy attached, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Woobat
flavor_text: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

text.name: Happy Return
text.text: Put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

text.name: Reflect
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.name: Telekinesis
text.text: This attack does 70 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

text.name: Focused Wish
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

text.name: Extended Damagriiigus
text.text: Move all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.name: Perplex
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

text.name: Fortunate Eye
text.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

name: Frillish
flavor_text: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

text.name: Oceanic Gloom
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

text.name: Harden
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks if that damage is 40 or less.

name: Boldore
flavor_text: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

text.name: Smack Down
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has {F} Resistance, this attack does 50 more damage.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

text.name: Vengeful Cannon
text.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched {F} Pokémon.

name: Sawk
flavor_text: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

text.name: Rising Chop
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't a Pokémon ex, this attack does nothing. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

name: Archen
flavor_text: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

text.name: Acrobatics
text.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

name: Archeops
flavor_text: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

text.name: Ancient Wing
text.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may devolve 1 of your opponent's evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

text.name: Smash Uppercut
text.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

text.name: Retaliate
text.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

text.name: Invite Evil
text.text: Search your deck for up to 3 {D} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

text.name: Knock Off
text.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

text.name: Ruffians Attack
text.text: Flip a coin for each {D} Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

text.name: Gunk Shot
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

text.name: Take Down
text.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Zoroark
flavor_text: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

text.name: Mind Jack
text.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

text.name: Foul Play
text.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

name: Vullaby
flavor_text: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: Mandibuzz
flavor_text: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

text.name: Look for Prey
text.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less that you find there onto your opponent's Bench.

name: Deino
flavor_text: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

text.name: Body Slam
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

text.name: Double Hit
text.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

text.name: Power Whip
text.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Durant
flavor_text: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

text.name: Bite Together
text.text: If Durant is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

text.name: Shred
text.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.name: Ambush
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

text.name: Procurement
text.text: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

text.name: Focus Energy
text.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Hyper Fang attack's base damage is 240.

text.name: Hyper Fang
text.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Lillipup
flavor_text: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

text.name: Play Rough
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Herdier
flavor_text: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

text.name: Roar
text.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

name: Stoutland
flavor_text: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

text.name: Odor Sleuth
text.text: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.

text.name: Special Fang
text.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 100 more damage.

text.name: Energy Gift
text.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.name: Wondrous Cotton
text.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Item cards or Pokémon Tool cards from their hand.

flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
